title: Cloudflare Dynamic Workers — 100x Faster AI Agent Code Sandboxing (Open Beta)

evaluation.reasoning: Official Cloudflare open beta (March 24, 2026). V8 isolate-based sandboxing with <5ms startup (vs ~500ms for Linux containers), priced at $0.002/unique Worker/day (free during beta). Genuinely novel infrastructure primitive for agent-generated code execution at the edge — distinct from Deno sandbox (local, single-runtime) and AIO Sandbox (multi-runtime Docker). The 100x startup advantage is directly relevant to agentic loops that need rapid code execution feedback. No direct Claude Code integration required — this is a companion architectural pattern. Capability expansion 80: novel category (edge-deployed code sandbox) not covered by existing capabilities. Integration complexity 85: documentation technique, no workspace code changes. Action: document in library/techniques/ as edge code sandbox pattern. Reference from agent design patterns when building code-executing agents. Monitor beta-to-GA announcement.
